title: Microsoft Purview DLP: restrict access to Fabric semantic models and lakehouses
notes: claim 71: severity blocker on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The briefing overstates an evaluation limitation: unsupported advanced classifiers do not prevent other classifiers in the same policy from returning matches. Its impact rationale also incorrectly says users notice the change only after losing access, although owners can receive policy tips without losing access.

claims.claim: The change adds a DLP restrict access action for Fabric semantic models and lakehouses.
claims.quote: DLP restrict access action allows you to block access to guest users or all users depending on what labels or sensitive information types matches your semantic models or lakehouses.

claims.claim: MC937920 specifically identifies preventing accidental guest access to sensitive information as a use case.
claims.quote: This action is especially valuable when your organization has guest users, and you want to enforce proper restrictions to ensure these users do not accidentally access sensitive information.
